The Jaeger-LeCoultre Master Grande Memovox is encased in 41.5mm of rose gold surrounding a silver dial on a black alligator strap. Features of this Jaeger-LeCoultre Master Grande Memovox include alarm, hours, minutes, seconds, day, date, month, perpetual calendar and moon phase. This Jaeger-LeCoultre watch also measures 15.7mm in thickness and 49.7mm from lug-to-lug.
